```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {s t : Finset α} [DecidableEq α] (h : s ⋖ t) : ∃ a ∈ t, t.erase a = s := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hsubset⟩ := h
  use a
  apply Finset.erase_eq_iff_eq_insert.1
  · exact ha
  · rw [Finset.erase_eq_iff_eq_insert.2 ha hsubset]
    exact Eq.trans (Finset.erase_subset_iff_of_mem.1 ha) hsubset
```
